title: Shoyu Ramen with Pork
description: A rich and savory Japanese-inspired ramen dish featuring braised pork and a flavorful shoyu broth.
instructions: 1. Cut the pork shoulder into 1-inch cubes and season with salt.
2. Heat the pork fat or oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the pork until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Remove the pork from the pot and set aside.
4. Add the yellow onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
5. Add the ramen broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
6. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
7. Add the cooked pork back to the pot and simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
8. Cook the shoyu ramen noodles according to the package instructions.
9. Divide the noodles among bowls and ladle the hot pork and broth over the top.
10. Garnish with green onions, sesame seeds, and a drizzle of soy sauce.
